recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Do not reintroduce Device patient association or the older DeviceAssociation operation backbone for this issue; later Applied R6 decisions supersede those details. If diagram freshness matters, regenerate generated-looking SVG artifacts separately rather than hand-editing them as part of FHIR-38904.
issue_request: FHIR-38904 was Published with resolution Persuasive with Modification for R5. It requested a new DeviceAssociation resource and removal of Device.association patient/body/operation association data from Device to prevent reusable Device instances from carrying patient-identifying history.
initial_application: DeviceAssociation was added to the build in commit 620b8fa10c746066887014813e72cf08475a42c0. FHIR-38904 commit 97e59d026d9311992199080e53a49ec78cf6aae5 commented out the active Device.operation and Device.association structures, including Device.association.humanSubject/bodyStructure, and FHIR-38904 QA commit 7a135eb3489ef36b8935e36d80d88b1729a2e8e8 added DeviceAssociation operation/operator/period changes. Current Device subject/patient search-parameter remnants are also inside XML comments and do not feed active build output.
additional_context: FHIR-39226 and FHIR-39243 are same-change-family R4 tickets that link to FHIR-38904 and are already represented on the combined branch. Later Applied R6 decisions refined the DeviceAssociation design: FHIR-46968 clarified subject versus operator, FHIR-47604 removed the DeviceAssociation operation/operator backbone and added focus, and FHIR-53628 documents that operation was collapsed into other elements with DeviceAssociation.relationship carrying the operator role. Current source/fhir.ini keeps Device and DeviceAssociation active, and compartments put DeviceAssociation rather than Device in patient/subject/focus compartments.
reconciliation: No source change was made. XML parsing found no active Device.patient, Device.subject, Device.association, Device.operation, Device subject search parameter, or Device patient search parameter. Active DeviceAssociation source contains device, relationship, subject, focus, bodyStructure, and period, plus subject, patient, focus, and date search parameters. Narrative guidance points implementers from Device to DeviceAssociation for ownership/custodianship and from DeviceAssociation to Observation for settings over time.
